cover.concept: Studio still life on flat saturated orange: one crisp sheet of paper standing upright in a brass bulldog clip, crumpled sheets scattered around it.
cover.lineDraft: The one they shortlist shows what you built.

slides.label: Rule 1
slides.idea: One page; a 1st/2nd-year has no reason for two

slides.label: Rule 2
slides.idea: Projects go first, each with what it does and a link

slides.label: Rule 3
slides.idea: Say what you built and who uses it, not adjectives

slides.label: Rule 4
slides.idea: Every link works: GitHub, live demo, LinkedIn; click each one

slides.label: Rule 5
slides.idea: Cut the objective line and words like hardworking
friend who says "my résumé is fine"

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Photoreal studio still life, magazine-ad quality, crisp soft light, subtle film grain. On a flat, seamless, saturated orange backdrop: one crisp blank white sheet of paper stands upright, held in a brass bulldog clip, while five crumpled paper balls lie scattered around its base. The objects sit in the lower 60% of the frame; the top 35% is plain orange backdrop. Portrait 2:3, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.
